name: software-builder
description: Turn an idea into working software without knowing how to code: a plain-language interview, a plan you approve, a chosen look, a safe build, a customer-eye check and a guided launch, in your language.

interface.longDescription: Shape your idea in plain words, approve a one-page plan, pick a look, then build, check like a real customer and go live, in your own language. Your project's memory is saved in a product/ folder so you can continue any time, in any AI tool.
defaultPrompt: I have an idea for an app. Can you help me build it?
Is my app ready for real customers?
Help me put my app online
